text:
Alex: noticed embeddings route in console shows sampled 0% over last hour but SRE traces include sampled payloads. Anyone else?
Priya: yeah saw that, probably a routing override. pinging Sam to look at dynamic quotas :eyes:
Sam: looking. initial hypothesis: per-tenant quota backpressure hit and our runtime falls back to 'drop-sample' policy which doesn't reflect in console aggregate because console uses route-level config, not effective policy stack.
Jo: can you share the query/trace id so I can correlate?
Alex: trace id 01FZ3Qabcde — curl we used:
```bash
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \
  -d '{"model":"embed-x","input":"..."}' \
  https://api.redwood.example/v1/embeddings
```

Sam: confirmed — router.log shows this for that trace:
```json
{"route":"/v1/embeddings","tenant":"acme-corp","policy_stack":["global-sampler:5%","quota-throttle:0%","canary-unmask:100%"],"effective":0}
```
Priya: that policy_stack ordering is the key. console currently shows `global-sampler:5%` only; it doesn't display middle 'quota-throttle' override.
Jo: UX ask: can we surface 'effective sampling' and an explain link that shows the rule stack and why effective ended up at X? e.g. mouseover shows stack ranked by priority with match conditions.
Alex: +1. Also expose a per-route 'why-scrubbed' link on request detail to help SREs and support.
Sam: workplan proposal:
- short term: compute effective_sampling at ingest and emit metric `route.effective_sampling` for dashboard (1 day)
- mid term: add 'explain' modal in console showing policy_stack and rule matchers (2 sprints)
- ops: add Alert that fires when effective_sampling deviates >5% from configured route sampler (1 sprint)

Priya: technical constraints: computing effective requires running routing mutator code path; extra CPU on hot path. We can do async evaluate in router worker and enrich span metadata instead of inline.
Jo: for UI design, want a compact stack view with collapsible conditions, and link to rule source (policy id). Also show last matched evaluation timestamp.
ops-bot: deploy started: routing-service v2.14.3 -> canary (10%) by Sam at 3312346030 :shipit:

Sam: quick interim patch I'll push: console query will join in `quota-throttle` as 'overrides' by checking runtime metadata; if not available fallback to showing 'possible overrides: quota-throttle'
Alex: thx. can we also add a small tooltip: "effective sampling is computed at request routing time and may differ due to quota/backpressure/fallbacks" ?
Priya: and include a link to runbook in the modal: https://redwood.company/runbooks/sampling-explain
Jo: assigning: Sam (metric), Priya (router enrichment), Jo (UI), Alex (support docs). Anyone object?
Priya: no objections. I'll start a PR for router enrichment and add unit tests for policy precedence.
Sam: PR up in 30m, will add a debug CLI to print policy stack for given trace id.
Alex: perfect. Thanks all. :tada:
